title: A stream or a lump sum
hook: Two stated cases: explore the discounting of an identical payment stream.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the discounting of an identical payment stream affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Present, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the discounting of an identical payment stream in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
